day_local: Talaadada Usbuuca Todoba iyo Tobnaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo joogitaanka Rabbidu ha idinla joogaan.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
Masiixow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Ma jiraan maalmood aad dib ugu eegto noloshaada, adigoo dareemaya inaad muddo dheer ku socotay waddo khaldan, ama adigoo la yaabban sida ay si lama filaan ah gacanta Ilaah kuugu soo jeedisay dhinaca kale? Halkaas ayaynu maanta ka billaabaynaa, intaanan xitaa gelin wax kasta oo kale. Ka feker qof taariikhdiisa oo dhan beddelay, oo aan ahayn sababtoo ah wuxuu qorsheeyay, laakiin sababtoo ah waxaa la qabtay isagoo socda. 

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'cagaha taagan'. Akhriska koowaad, Bawlos wuxuu u sheegayaa Galatiyada waddadiisii hore: sida uu u ahaa nin ku adag dhaqankiisii hore, nin burburin jiray kaniisadda, ilaa uu ka kulmay ninkaas oo calaamadiyey tan iyo uurka hooyadiis. Bawlos ma uusan doonin Yeruusaalem isla markiiba; wuxuu aaday saxaraha, wuxuu la joogay aamusnaanta. Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah ee aan maanta xusuusaneyno, wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida cagtiisa loogu dhigo dhulka si adag. Xusuusnow markii uu dhisayey koodhka barnaamijyadiisa ee GitHub, ama markii uu garoomada diyaaradaha ku eegayay boosaska diyaaradaha, isagoo ka fikiraaya shirkaddiisa 'con chim airlines' ee uu jeclaa inuu asaso. Indhihiisu ma ahayn kuwo ku kooban halkaan; waxay eegayeen meel fog, halkaas oo maskaxdiisa iyo hamigiisu ay ka wada shaqeynayeen.

Laakiin ka hor intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si dhab ah u wajahno xanuunka taagan. Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay yihiin kuwo adag, oo ay jiraan waqtiyo ay gurigu dareemayo inuu yahay mid aamusnaan qoto dheer leh. Waxaa jira habeenro aad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culculus oo aan jawaab lahayn: 'Muxuu Ben u tagay si degdeg ah? Ma jirtay wax aan seegnay?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno, oo aan si daacad ah idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka aad qaadaysaan waa mid culus, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid adinku keenteen. Xusuusnow, Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbi saafi ah, wiil shan iyo toban jir ah oo unprompted u sheegay waalidkiis inuu doonayo inuu bixiyo dhammaan piggy bank-giisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jacaylkiisu uu ahaa mid aan xad lahayn.

Oo halkaas ayay Injiilka maanta ku soo gelaysaa si qoto dheer. Ciise wuxuu galay tuulo, waxaana soo dhaweysay Marta. Marta waxay ku mashquulsanayd adeegyo badan, wayna walwalsanayd. Laakiin Maryan waxay fadhiisatay cagaha Rabbiga agtooda, oo waxay dhageysatay codkiisa. Marta waxay tiri: 'Rabbiyow, miyaadan dan ka lahayn in walaashay kaligeed i dhaaftay?' Ciise wuxuu u jawaabay: 'Marta, Marta, adigu waad walwalsan tahay oo dhibtooneysaa waxyaalo badan. Waxaa loo baahan yahay hal shay oo keliya. Maryan waxay dooratay qaybta ka fiican, mana laga qaadi doono.' 

... Halkaas ayay tahay meesha ay tahay inaan joogsanno. Waqtiyada qaar, nolosheenna oo dhan waxay u egtahay mid ay ka buuxaan shaqooyin, walwal, iyo isku day ah inaan wax walba gacanta ku hayno. Waxaan dhiseynaa barnaamijyo, waxaan maamuleynaa shirkado, waxaan qorsheyneynaa safarro toban magaalo ah sida Alan iyo Ben ay sameeyeen. Laakiin waxaa yimaada xilli uu Rabbigu ku leeyahay: 'Jooji. Fadhiiso cagahayga agtooda.' Ben hadda wuxuu fadhiyaa cagaha Rabbiga agtooda. Wuxuu joogaa meel aanay jirin daal, meel aanay jirin shaqo badan oo walwal leh. Wuxuu ku jiraa Banquet of Heaven, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo halkan jooga, waxaan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in booska Ben uu yahay mid bannaan. Laakiin xusuuso in jacaylkiisu uu kula joogo. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad horay u socoto, inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa inuu arko. Ha ka baqin inaad ku noolaato noloshaada si buuxda, waayo Ben wuxuu kaaga tagay dhaxal aan dhimanayn.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, oo ha ka baqin inaad wakhti ku qaadato aamusnaanta, adigoo u oggolaanaya Rabbigu inuu ku xaqiijiyo jacaylkiisa. Ben wuxuu ku jiraa nabadda Aabbaha, wuxuuna idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow gacaliye, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Talalka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax kasta, waxaana rabaa inaad nafteyda gashato. Maadaama aanan hadda heli karin Sakramentka, fadqalalo qalbigayga ruux ahaan. Waxaan ku aqoonsanahay inaad halkaan joogto, mana u oggolaan doonid inaan kaa go'o weligay. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin xafido; Rabbigu ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa maanta iyo weligiisba. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: In wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan intii dhimatay ay ku nastaan nuurka iyo nabadda Masiix.
In Ilaah uu qaboojiyo quluubta dhammaan kuwa la xanuunsanaya murugada, oo uu siiyo rajada weligeed ah.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaow, waxaad maqliseen hab-nololeedkaygii hore ee diinta Yuhuudda, sida aan xad-dhaaf u silcin jiray kaniisadda Ilaah oo u dayday inaan burburiyo, oo aan uga dhex horumaray Yuhuudda qaar badan oo la fac ahaa dadkayga ah, maaddaama aan aad ugu xeeldheeraa dhaqannadii awowgay. Laakiin markii kii uurka hooyaday iga soocay oo naxariistiisa igu yeeray uu raalli ku noqday inuu Wiilkiisa igu muujiyo, si aan ugu wacdiyo dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn, isla markiiba kala tashan maayo hilib iyo dhiig, mana aan aadin Yeruusaalem kuwii ergayga ii horreeyey; balse waxaan aadey Carabiya, dabadeedna dib ugu laabtay Dimishiq. Dabadeed saddex sannadood ka dib waxaan aaday Yeruusaalem inaan la tashado Kefas, oo waxaan la joogay shan iyo toban maalmood. Laakiin ma aan arag ergo kale oo ãy ahayn Yacquub, walaalkii Rabbiga. (Waxa aan idiin qorayo, bal eeg, Ilaah horteed ma aan beensanayo.) Dabadeed waxaan aaday degaannada Suuriya iyo Kilikiya. Qoysaskii kaniisadaha Yahuudiya ee ku jira Masiixu ima ay aqoon fool ka fool; waxay keliya maqleen in 'kii na silcin jiray uu hadda wacdiyaya iimaankii uu mar dayday inuu burburiyo.' Sidaas daraaddeed waxay Ilaah ku amaaneen aawaday.

readings.label: Sabuurka Jawaabta
readings.text:
R. I hagi, Rabbiyow, jidka waarta.
O RABBI, waad i baartay oo waad i garaneysaa;
waad garaneysaa markaan fadhiisto iyo markaan istaago;
fikradahayga fog ayaad ka garaneysaa.
Safarradayda iyo nasashadayda waad baartaa,
jidadkayga oo dhan waad la socotaa.
R. I hagi, Rabbiyow, jidka waarta.
Xaqiiqiyan adiga ayaa sameeyay gudahayga;
waxaad igu tidicday uurka hooyaday.
Waan ku mahadinayaa inaan si cabsi leh oo layaab leh u samaysanahay;
shuqulladaadu waa kuwo layaab leh.
R. I hagi, Rabbiyow, jidka waarta.
Naftayduna si fiican bay ku ogayd;
mana aysan kaa qarsoonayn qaabkaygu
Markii la iga dhex sameeyay qarsoodiga,
markii layga dhex dhisay moolka dhulka.
R. I hagi, Rabbiyow, jidka waarta.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu galay tuulo uu haweenay la yiraahdo Marta ay ku soo dhaweysay gurigeeda. Waxay lahayd walaashay la yiraahdo Maryan, taas oo fadhiisatay cagaha Rabbiga agtooda oo dhageysanaysay hadalkiisa. Marta waxaa ku cuslaaday adeegid badan, markaasay u timid oo tiri, 'Rabbiyow, miyaadan dan ka lahayn in walaashay kaligeed i dhaaftay inaan adeego? U sheeg inay i caawiso.' Rabbigu wuxuu ugu jawaabay, 'Marta, Marta, adigu waad walwalsan tahay oo dhibtooneysaa waxyaalo badan. Waxaa loo baahan yahay hal shay oo keliya. Maryan waxay dooratay qaybta ka fiican, mana laga qaadi doono.'

day: Tuesday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.
